title: Our Help Is in the Name of the Lord

questions.question: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side—let Israel now do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:1 (ESV): "If it had not been the Lord who was on our side—let Israel now say—"

questions.question: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side when people rose up against whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:2 (ESV): "...when people rose up against us,"

questions.question: Then they would have swallowed us up how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:3 (ESV): "then they would have swallowed us up alive,"

questions.question: When their anger was kindled against whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:3 (ESV): "...when their anger was kindled against us;"

questions.question: Then the flood would have swept us away, the torrent would have gone over whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:4 (ESV): "then the flood would have swept us away, the torrent would have gone over us;"

questions.question: Then over us would have gone the raging what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:5 (ESV): "then over us would have gone the raging waters."

questions.question: Blessed be the Lord, who has not given us as prey to their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:6 (ESV): "Blessed be the Lord, who has not given us as prey to their teeth!"

questions.question: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:7 (ESV): "We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowlers;"

questions.question: The snare is broken, and we have what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:7 (ESV): "the snare is broken, and we have escaped!"

questions.question: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:8 (ESV): "Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth."

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 124?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124 Title: "A Song of Ascents. Of David."

questions.question: What metaphor is used to describe the enemies' anger?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:3 (ESV): "...when their anger was kindled against us;"

questions.question: What metaphor is NOT used in this Psalm to describe the enemies?
questions.explanation: While "prey to their teeth" might imply beasts, "Lions" is not explicitly used, unlike floods and fowlers.

questions.question: The phrase "if it had not been the Lord who was on our side" is repeated how many times?
The escape is compared to a bird escaping what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 124:7 (ESV): "...from the snare of the fowlers;"

key_verse_text: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
